correctness.rationale: The exact affine-plane incidence model is defined. Every minimum LTD set has four selected points and four selected lines: coverage forces three per side and a three-point/three-line boundary demands at least six selections on the other side. Four-point covers necessarily consist of one omitted-direction line plus one point, by pair-collision counting; four-line covers consist of a complete retained parallel class plus one line, by point-coverage counting. Signature separation forces the extra line through the intersection of the omitted line and the retained class line through the extra point; both allowed choices satisfy every open signature condition. There are 3*3*3*2*2=108 minima. Each legal single exchange changes one of two independent binary choices, giving 27 C4; bipartite adjacency forbids token slides. Three standalone executables independently passed at their final local package paths.

value.rationale: The exact minimum-layer classification of a canonical cubic bipartite Levi graph yields more than a modest numeric improvement: 108 optimal monitoring configurations form 27 independent four-cycle exchange sectors yet zero adjacency slides. The affine-plane proof explains how deleting one parallel class determines all optimal placements and the precise mobility obstruction. These properties are natural for reliable sensor deployment and cannot be inferred from an LTD minimum or general girth bounds.
